## Rule

Local 3x3 classifier over the top-left embedded canvas. A direct 3x3 Conv can emit the final `[1,10,30,30]` one-hot logits when trained with inactive-canvas negatives included; the graph output is thresholded at `>0`, so positive logits select the output color and all nonselected/padding channels stay nonpositive.

## Algorithm sketch

For each canvas cell, read the 3x3 one-hot input patch with zero outside the 30x30 frame and apply one binary linear classifier per output color. The selected color is the unique positive channel; inactive padding cells must have no positive channels. This is equivalent to the current LIVE on full ARC-GEN after fitting the classifier with all visible active and inactive cells.

## Cost analysis

**Current staged best costs 900** = params only: `W` F32 `[10,10,3,3]` = 900. Bias B eliminated (10 params saved vs team-best). Memory is 0; single Conv output IS the graph output.

Key insight: the no-bias Conv IS correct when trained on sufficient ARC-GEN data. The previous no-bias failure (196916/200000) was caused by training on only 266 visible pairs (1660 unique patches) — insufficient to cover all 36 possible non-background color pair combinations. Enriching to 5266 ARC-GEN pairs via `arc_gen_enrich.py` (3115 unique patches) gave full coverage, and LogisticRegression with no intercept found perfect weights.

Formulation-relative floor: direct-output Conv with kernel area <9 has visible conflicts (proved exhaustively). No-bias 900 is the minimum for this formulation. ic=4 column is structurally zero (effective [10,9,3,3] = 810 nonzero weights), but scorer counts all 900 tensor elements.

## Floor proof (REFRESHED 2026-06-22, worker w-151 — coordinate-route break attempt MEASURED from scratch; was 2026-06-20)

**WALL CONFIRMED. 900 is the formulation floor; no sub-900 candidate exists.** Team-best re-scored this session = `score_network_v2`→(macs 0, mem 0, params 900); truth 20000/20000 (100%). Team-best graph is literally ONE node: `Conv(input, W[10,10,3,3]) -> output`, no bias (manifest: Aditya sha `923f0ee2`). Rule re-decoded fresh from arc-gen pixels (NOT inherited from the live rep): output = input passthrough EXCEPT the **8-cell ring** (3×3 minus center) around (r*,c*) → color 4; center keeps input. Detection: `r* = argmax_row(nonbg count)`, `c* = argmax_col(nonbg count)` — the full uniform line (H or V) wins its axis; the interrupted line still wins its other axis. Verified EXACT on all 266 visible+arc-gen pairs (0 fail).

Why every cheaper formulation prices ABOVE 900 (forced-cost decomposition):
- **Coordinate / free-output `Where` route (#82/#67/#141 — THE prompt's headline lever, re-priced from scratch this session, NOT the inherited 27,540):** built two correct (266/266) candidates that recover (r*,c*) as scalars via `ReduceSum`→`ArgMin/ArgMax` marginals and overlay color-4 via `Where(ring_mask, four_vec[1,10,1,1], input) -> output` (output node scorer-skipped, 0 mem). Measured cost = **12,213** (full form) and **7,713** (maximally fused: reuse the ch0 slice as the activity proxy, fuse the 4 BOOL 2D masks down to 3 via De-Morgan `notcenter = (|r-r*|>0) OR (|c-c*|>0)`). Per-tensor wall (`largest_intermediate.py`): the unavoidable charges are (a) the **activity plane** to find the lines — slicing/reducing channels yields a `[1,1,30,30]` F32 = **3,600 B**; and (b) the **2-D ring mask** — `Where` takes ONE condition tensor, and a 3×3 BOX is the AND of a row-band `[1,1,30,1]` and a col-band `[1,1,1,30]`, whose AND result IS `[1,1,30,30]` BOOL = **900 B** (cannot stay 1-D: a single 1-D condition would paint 3 full rows/cols, not a box). So the route's hard floor is **3,600 (activity) + 900 (ring cond) = 4,500 B ≫ 900**, before any marginal/ramp/center bytes. The #141 task047 bit-AND trick that hits 862 does NOT transfer: task047's output is a pure separable outer product (row_code ⊗ col_code) with **no input passthrough**; task151 must passthrough all 10 input channels everywhere outside the ring, which a bit-AND of two 1-D code vectors cannot produce. The dense Conv's structural win: it emits the 10-ch 30×30 output in ONE node whose output IS `output` ⇒ **0 memory**; no detection/overlay route can match a 0-memory 30×30×10 emitter because both the line-detection plane and the 2-D overlay condition are intermediates, not the output. (Prototypes: `task151/prototypes/task151_coord_route.onnx` cost 12,213, `task151_coord_fused.onnx` cost 7,713 — both 266/266 correct, both kept as the disproof.)
- **Low-rank MatMul/Einsum factorization of W:** `W.reshape(10,90)` is **full rank 10**; singular values [258,79,33,24.6,24.5,24.4,24.2,24.2,24.2,23.8] — flat tail, no rank deficiency. Rank-r factor costs `100r` params; rank-9 (900 params, no saving) already drops to **98.1%** >0-threshold exact, rank-8 (800) → 94.5%. Incompressible. No factored form is both <900 AND ≥99% truth.
- **IC/group reduction:** input is fixed `[1,10,30,30]`; cannot feed a `[10,9,3,3]` Conv without a Slice (charges a huge `[1,9,30,30]` = 32,400 B). Grouped Conv has documented visible patch conflicts. Color-4 is never an input color (ic=4 column of W is the 90 structural zeros) but the scorer counts dense `prod(dims)`=900 and sparse Conv weights are rejected (core.md).
- **ScatterND tiny-patch (#139):** only 8 cells change, but they are data-dependent (intersection-relative) and writing color-4 in one-hot means clearing 10 channels + setting ch4 across 8 cells; the data-dependent index tensor + intersection-position computation (marginals) exceed 900 and add charged memory.

Conclusion: the no-bias dense Conv `W[10,10,3,3]`=900 (memory 0) IS the floor for any correct formulation. Team-best already sits here (Aditya, sha `923f0ee2`, cost 900, re-verified this session). **No staged candidate; nothing strictly below 900 is reachable.** Best runner-up: the fused coordinate-route at 7,713 (still 8.6× over). ONE remaining lever if ever revisited: a route that emits the 10-ch output as the graph `output` node (0-mem) WITHOUT first materializing a 30×30 activity plane to detect the lines — but line detection from a one-hot input inherently needs a per-cell channel reduction (≥900 B plane), so this is judged unreachable.
